# Onda for Mac 1.1.0 beta 127 — Reliable startup and music recovery
- Fix a crash that could freeze Onda's interface and later close the app when Spotify or Apple Music's audio processes changed. - Improve music recovery after overlapping calls and video, including when Onda restarts during an interruption. Music Onda paused resumes only when it is still eligible and the output is ready. - Preserve saved room-speaker levels in expanded Wi-Fi groups. - Keep your volume, individual speaker balance, timing, room tuning and automatic call/video switching when updating.
This universal beta supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs. The app and installer are Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. The bundled audio driver remains 1.0.5 build 6; no driver update is needed.
With automatic updates enabled, Onda checks daily and downloads the update. Installation happens when you quit Onda. You can also use Settings → Check for Updates.
Validation: 367 Swift tests, with six fixture/environment skips and no failures. Astra independently reviewed the crash fix and its regression and runtime evidence. The original live crash was reproduced before the fix; the fixed release survived music-process changes and restart during playback. Live muted Google Meet and video checks on installed beta 127 confirmed display-only playback, then automatic Spotify and Bluetooth room-speaker return at the same volume and balance. Intel builds are verified by compilation and package validation; live listening was checked on Apple silicon.
The iPhone app and its App Store release are unchanged.
